question: How is the deity as cause of the ages and embodiment of true duty saluted?
premises: The deity is related as cause to the kṛta and other ages
The deity is addressed as true duty
Obeisance is offered to this deity
inference: Obeisance is paid to the deity who is the cause of the ages and embodies true duty.
uncertainties: The split tokens hetubhūta and -taḥ make the exact form uncertain
plain_english: O one who is the cause of the kṛta and other ages, O embodiment of true duty, obeisance be to you.
